+    def setup_method(self):
+        # Get the directory where this current file is saved
+        self.testPath = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

+        # Create a temporary directory for the test files

+        self.tmp_config_path = self.tmp_path / "filter.yaml"
+        self.tmp_config_path.write_text("""
+myelinated:
+  - valid-g-ratio-only: True
+  - axon-diam-gt: ~
+
+unmyelinated:
+  - axon-diam-gt: ~
+  - solidity-gt: ~

+    @pytest.mark.unit

+    @pytest.mark.unit
